item.text: {"hypothesis_status":"not_supported","summary":"L019 executed successfully but failed both eligibility criteria. Its pooled weighted training OOF MAE was 8.0058 K, 0.2532 K worse than A05's 7.7526 K and above the eligible threshold of 7.7426 K. Its positive-Tc MAE was 9.0225 K, exceeding the fixed G01 guard of 8.8322 K by 0.1903 K, so it cannot be an eligible win. Relative to the cluster2 extra_trees/raw ablation L013, log1p improved reported-zero MAE from 5.8521 K to 5.7466 K but worsened positive-Tc MAE from 8.9496 K to 9.0225 K, pooled MAE from 7.9882 K to 8.0058 K, and cluster2 route MAE from 2.9293 K to 2.9824 K. High-Tc MAE remained unchanged at 32.7716 K because cluster2 has no high-Tc rows. Restricting log1p to this low-temperature route therefore preserved the familiar zero-versus-positive tradeoff rather than making it favorable.","next_action":"continue","next_focus":"The continuation minimum remains pending, with 19 of 22 successful unique cycles completed. Test the untried chemistry interaction previously motivated by the closest raw-target A05 variants: composition input, chemistry routing, global hist_gradient_boosting/raw, a cu_o extra_trees/raw expert, and an other hist_gradient_boosting/raw expert, with fe_anion using the global fallback. L007 found that changing only other to hist_gradient_boosting/raw missed A05 by just 0.0086 K while improving positive-Tc MAE, while L001 isolated hist_gradient_boosting/raw fallback for fe_anion. Combining those changes tests whether their route-specific effects interact favorably while preserving A05's cu_o expert. It is falsified as an eligible improvement unless pooled weighted OOF MAE is below 7.742598770753422 K and positive-Tc MAE is at most 8.832165507919859 K; subgroup gains without both conditions remain tradeoffs.","stop_reason":"","limitations":["All measurements are adaptive development evidence from reused fixed-group training OOF folds, not independent validation or proof of generalization.","L019 failed the deterministic positive-Tc guard and is ineligible regardless of its reported-zero improvement.","KMeans cluster identities may shift between folds, and the partitions are operational composition rules rather than verified physical families.","The observed historical counterexamples do not identify new superconductors."]}
